gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the default classification level for my project so that I can ensure it aligns with our organizational standards.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current default classification level for the specified project, including details such as the classification name and description.

gold.user: As a compliance officer, I need to update the default classification level for a project to reflect new regulatory requirements, ensuring that all project data is properly classified.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the new classification level details and return a success message confirming the update, along with the updated classification information.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to remove the default classification level for a project that is no longer applicable, to prevent confusion among team members.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully delete the default classification level and return a confirmation message indicating that the classification has been removed.
